portfolio.title: This Website
portfolio.reason: The website portfolio itself. It involved light web development, programming, and fair deal of recording and editing. A great deal of credit goes to my friend Zulius Roolf for the template and the help.

portfolio.title: Award: Outstanding Bachelor’s Thesis
portfolio.reason: At the conclusion of our thesis, my group and I won the Outstanding Bachelor Thesis Award for our perspective on the visually impaired and our theoretical and managerial contributions in that space.

portfolio.title: Bachelor Thesis
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: Visually impaired people and their experience in supermarkets
portfolio.reason: Me and my group wanted to explore both customer experience and a topic that was outside the box. We chose to focus on visually impaired individuals and their experiences in supermarkets. The result was a fascinating and well-researched paper.

portfolio.title: Student Dormitory Life
portfolio.reason: In this project, we get a glimpse of Ella’s dorm life. The composition in this one is my favorite, and it clearly shows how much more confident my filming has become.

portfolio.title: Student Unions at LNU
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: A mashup video of all the associations
portfolio.reason: In this project, I aimed to shine a spotlight on all the associations at the university. Inspired by mashup videos online, I wanted to put my own spin on the concept. As an editing-heavy project, it remains one of my proudest accomplishments.

portfolio.title: Marine Engineering with Yasmin
portfolio.reason: In this project, I engaged with a student and gave her space to share her experience as a marine engineer. Down to the questions and music to the overall coordination, the project felt down-to-earth and relatable, which is reflected in the strong engagement through comments and likes.

portfolio.title: Advent Calendar of Student Tips
portfolio.reason: This was my first attempt at speaking directly to the camera, delivering a monologue to inform and engage others.

portfolio.title: Halloween 2023 Collage
portfolio.reason: My very first official assignment as a social media ambassador, and I decided capture and showcase an event through a curated collage of photos and videos, sharing the experience with LNU’s Instagram audience.

portfolio.title: Podcast Host and Editor
portfolio.collaborators: Oscar T, Tova I & Johanna E
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: A creative way to show course work
portfolio.reason: In my project marketing course, we were challenged by the professor to present our group work through means other than the traditional presentation style. I came up with the idea to showcase the project through a podcast, incorporating music, an ad, and a scripted collaboration with my group mates. This experience marked my first step into the editing space, where I worked on music selection, scriptwriting, and also took on the role of host.

portfolio.title: Mentor for University Program
portfolio.reason: In my senior year of university, I was the go-to person for new students. Being there for others and sharing information, good vibes and strategies.

portfolio.title: Student Ambassador
portfolio.reason: I held multiple information tables and presentations as an ambassador. I coordinated and collaborated with the university, its faculties, and my team to ensure resources were ready to support student knowledge of union-related topics and enhance the student experience. This role was rich in administrative responsibilities, including logistics, documentation, and maintaining open engagement with students.

portfolio.title: Project Lead of Halloween Dinner Party
portfolio.reason: My debut into university life. I received the opportunity to project lead and be the spokesperson for the annual Halloween dinner for the whole economy faculty. From planning the whole event to coordinating with the team and serving as the public representative.

portfolio.title: School President
portfolio.descriptiveTitle: High school president for Creative Corp
portfolio.reason: This was my first entry point into leadership. I was nominated and selected by the previous board for my contribution, sense of responsibility and kindness to others. This role allowed me to develop both administrative and managerial skills.
